Tolong buatkan kode website personal branding profesional dalam satu file HTML tunggal (Single Page Application). 

IDENTITAS:
- Nama: Caesar A'zim Riyadi
- Role: AI Specialist & Power User
- WhatsApp: 085758287612
- Instagram: @liminilo

KONSEP VISUAL:
- Tema: Ultra-modern Dark Mode.
- Warna: Latar belakang #0a0a0a, aksen gradasi biru ke ungu (Electric Blue to Royal Purple).
- Framework: Tailwind CSS (via CDN) dan Lucide Icons/FontAwesome.
- Animasi: Gunakan AOS (Animate On Scroll) atau Tailwind Transition agar terlihat smooth.

NAVIGASI:
- Glassmorphism Navbar dengan link: Home, Skills, Portfolio, Contact.

SEKSI KONTEN:
1. HERO SECTION: Headline "The Future is Prompted." Teks utama: "Caesar A'zim Riyadi: Transforming Industries with Generative AI". Berikan tombol CTA "Chat on WhatsApp".
2. SKILLS/EXPERIENCE (Gunakan Grid 2x2):
   - Card 1: "Clip Video Automation" (Icon: Video). Deskripsi: Creating viral content workflows with AI automation.
   - Card 2: "AI Game Dev" (Icon: Gamepad). Deskripsi: Developing interactive simple games through advanced prompt engineering.
   - Card 3: "AI Music & Voice" (Icon: Music). Deskripsi: Multi-character AI song covers and voice synthesis.
   - Card 4: "AI Visual Arts" (Icon: Camera). Deskripsi: High-fidelity image and video generation in any artistic style.
3. SOCIAL PROOF: Link ke Instagram @liminilo dengan desain card yang estetik.
4. FOOTER: Tombol WhatsApp yang melayang (Floating Action Button) dan info kontak.

TEKNIS:
- Pastikan responsive (Mobile Friendly).
- Integrasikan link WhatsApp langsung ke: https://wa.me/6285758287612
- Integrasikan link Instagram ke: https://instagram.com/liminilo
- Gunakan placeholder gambar dari Unsplash yang bertema "Artificial Intelligence" atau "Abstract Tech".

Tampilkan seluruh kode dalam satu blok kode HTML yang siap saya save sebagai index.html.

**Analyzing the Contradiction**

I'm grappling with a fundamental incompatibility. The user seeks a single HTML file for Caesar Riyadi's personal brand website, but my core directives enforce a React application built with TypeScript and modular components. This clash demands a novel solution to bridge the gap between desired output and my defined architecture.


**Addressing the Discrepancy**

I've clarified the design brief and the technical constraints. While a single HTML file is requested, my core function involves creating a modular React application. To align with expectations, I will craft a high-quality React project adhering to the client's specifications (dark mode, Tailwind, glassmorphism) but as a standard React setup (App.tsx, index.tsx, etc.) instead of a single HTML output. The goal is to provide a world-class React solution.


**Prioritizing Smooth Interactions**

Now, I'm focusing on the animation aspect. Replacing AOS with `framer-motion` seems promising. For icons, `lucide-react` is the clear choice. Navigating towards a glassmorphism navbar is my immediate focus, which will be the first of a set of sections, including Hero, Skills, Social Proof and Footer, as the page architecture. I'll get placeholder images and build the sections with the tech I defined.


**Implementing the React Structure**

I'm now implementing the React structure. I'm building a standard React setup, with `metadata.json`, `index.html` (using Tailwind CDN), and the root files (`index.tsx`, `App.tsx`). This aligns with the "Single Page Application" interpretation, even if a single HTML file is not possible. The `App.tsx` will hold the main layout, state for the mobile menu and the smooth scroll structure. Following this will be each of the individual sections.


**Crafting the Components**

My current focus is on building the specific components that will constitute the website. I'm focusing on a grid layout for the `Skills` section, employing hover effects to enhance interactivity. For `SocialProof`, I'm evaluating an Instagram embed-like style or a custom card approach.  A sticky WhatsApp button will provide a user-friendly way to connect. I will also make color selections using the preferred palette.

Hero section with animated gradient text
Social proof section focusing on Instagram
